reviews.comment: Dr Rogers is a kind professor but not the most timely. As long as you go to class and she knows your name you will be fine. She has not graded papers that are due today which is annoying but she has not been too harsh of a grader.

Very very unclear and consistently changing syllabus. It is April and she still has not graded assignments from February but keeps assigning more papers. Not sure how she plans on grading or where I stand in the class. All over the place when it comes to lectures. Do not take this prof.

Dr. Rogers is the kindest professor ever! She really cares about your success! READ THE TEXTBOOK and study the slideshows for tests! Just do your work and do it well. It's straight-forward material but NOT a blow-off class! I highly recommend Rogers- she gives great advice for interviews for internships too! Cannot say enough good things!

Do not take this professor. She just rambles all of class and then gives you exams that are unrelated to anything she teaches. No clear grading criteria, contradicts her syllabus all the time. Takes FOREVER to post grades. She will assign more writing assignments than she can grade. Do not take her

Worst professor I've had at A&M in every sense. Inconsistent and arbitrary grader, very poor communication and preparation, doesn't handle feedback well, not an effective lecturer, and has terrible exams. Also, it's been over a week since final grades were due on Howdy and she still doesn't have them in. Incredibly unprofessional and unacceptable.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things
